+/-140 A contract range: 140*0.0005*20 = 1.4 V full-scale; matches 3.3 V ADC span centered at mid-rail; bandwidth 400 kHz >> e-freq 889 Hz
100 V rated > 50.4 V max bus with margin; 820 uF per 60 A cell adequate for 30 uH source inductance budget
51 V standoff vs 50.4 V max bus: only 0.6 V headroom. Battery-powered application has no load-dump; acceptable but tight. Consider SM8S58A if re-spin occurs.
